approval.scope: Amendment A v3, then Amendment B v4; DEV only; no meta-test access

format_instruction: Return only the requested answer token or string. Do not add an explanation, label, or surrounding quotation marks.

oracle_descriptions.composition: Reverse the input string character by character. Then replace every lowercase vowel (a, e, i, o, u) with {param2}. Leave all other characters unchanged.
oracle_descriptions.conditional: If the input begins with a lowercase vowel (a, e, i, o, u), append {param1} to the input. Otherwise, prepend {param2} to the input.
oracle_descriptions.permutation: Reverse the input string character by character.
oracle_descriptions.substitution: Replace every lowercase vowel (a, e, i, o, u) with {param1}. Leave all other characters unchanged.
